THE SURFACE IS JUST THE BEGINNING

TMRT is K. J. Somaiya's student-led marine robotics team we design, build and dive with real underwater vehicles. 1st & 2nd year students, all branches, welcome aboard.

WHAT IS TMRT?
We build underwater. Literally.

We're an interdisciplinary crew engineering AUVs, ROVs and autonomous systems from sewage-cleaning bots to groundwater-mapping drones combining mechanical, electronics and software from scratch to splashdown.

OUR ACHIEVEMENTS
Proof beneath the surface.
Research & Academic Edge
24 Scopus-indexed papers submitted, presented at ICTEAH ’25 & international symposiums.
  
Technological Innovations
Drone-based groundwater mapping, a robotic lake dredger & field-tested autonomous sub-surface rigs.
  
Workshops & Impact
College-wide 3D design bootcamps, tech fest exhibitions & ROS2 / STM32 training stacks.
